description: Relationship views over the accumulated estate. view='about' answers "tell me about X" whole: founder plane, activity plane, circle, and a ranked reading plan. Other views: 'families' (engagement channels by stem), 'person' (footprint + counterparts), 'initiatives' (what moved, by creator), 'convergence' (where a group co-occurs). Fold-first at zero Slack calls; bounded compiled searches only when coverage requires. about/person take render='graph' to also write the view as a static HTML graph page under the server's data directory.

days.description: Activity window in days (defaults: about/person 30, convergence 14, initiatives 7; capped at 90 — the attention ledger's horizon)

deeper.description: about only: second hop — compile the circle's activity with bounded searches and show where it converges

forceRefresh.description: channels: force refresh the channel cache from Slack (rate-limited)

includeDeleted.description: people/channels: include tombstoned entries as dated facts

limit.description: families/channels: maximum items to return (families default 10, channels default 50)

offset.description: Skip the first N items of the view's ranked lists — a cap never prevents paging; capped responses name the exact next call

people.description: Comma-separated people for the convergence view (at least two)

person.description: The seed person for about/person, or the creator anchor for families (@handle, name, or user ID)

render.description: about/person only: 'graph' also writes the view as a self-contained HTML graph report under the server's data directory (reports/, private 0600, replaced on each render) and returns its path and file:// URL with the usual markdown. Not available inside batch.

search.description: families: filter by stem or channel name (partial match; relaxes the default criteria). channels: name/purpose filter.

name: estate
